name: A Long Journey
source:
It is 2048. Life on Earth for humankind continues on a downward spiral. The people live in dangerous, cramped megacities as the environment degrades around them. Backed by government forces, the giant Hawkink Tech corporation has completed the first colony ships and launched them towards distant habitable planets.
MC is a bright young software engineer who has chosen to risk his life as a colonist in order to escape the dying earth and follow his dream of building a new society. But something goes wrong, and he wakes from cryo-sleep too early, finding himself alone on the giant empty ship as it hurtles through the void.
Soon he learns he is not the only one awake when he meets another person, a beautiful young woman with flaming red hair. She is angry and damaged from already spending many months awake and alone. Can they work together to find a way out of their trap? Or is there more to the situation it first appears...
translation:
公元2048年，地球上的人类生存境况持续恶化。周遭生态环境日益崩坏，人们挤在危机四伏、逼仄拥挤的巨型都市里苟延残喘。在政府势力的支持下，科技巨头霍金克科技集团建造完成了首批殖民星舰，并发射驶向遥远的宜居行星。
男主角是一名才华横溢的年轻软件工程师，为了逃离垂死的地球、追寻建立崭新社会的梦想，他毅然冒着生命危险报名成为殖民者。然而意外突生，他过早地从冷冻休眠中苏醒过来，发现自己孤身一人置身于疾驰在浩瀚虚空中的巨大空旷星舰之上。
不久后，当他邂逅另一名苏醒者——一位一头火红长发的年轻美貌女子时，才得知醒来的并非只有自己。独自清醒煎熬了数月的她满怀愤怒、身心俱疲。两人究竟能否携手合作逃出这座囚笼？还是说，眼前的处境背后另有隐情……
